# Third-party distributions

IEA-15-240-RWT model data: IEAWindSystems/IEA-15-240-RWT, Apache-2.0,
revision 86d51c8a1ee65be4f3686087a5c443c0b57e5cfb for the v5 migration.
Legacy v4 floating inputs derive from the local validated research baseline.

OpenFAST: OpenFAST/openfast, Apache-2.0, versions 4.1.1 and 5.0.0.
ROSCO: NREL/ROSCO, Apache-2.0, version 2.10.1.
Full license texts accompany these distributions in `licenses/`.
Source archives accompany the solver binaries in `sources/`.

Model input changes for v5 compatibility and relative controller paths are
recorded in model manifests and `docs/standalone_setup.md`. All original
copyright and attribution notices in distributed files are retained.
